parsed.note_claim: Mitch McConnell is alive and his office stated he continues to improve in the hospital and is working with his staff.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: "The Senator continues to improve, and is working closely with his staff on Kentucky and Senate matters while the Senate is out of session," the statement continued.
parsed.reason: The article directly quotes the senator's office confirming he is improving and working with staff, substantiating the note's claim that he is alive.
